page.layout: Running head top left; page number top right. Full-width running text at top, continuing from the previous page, cut off at the left edge. Ornamental rule below it. Centred heading "Prælectio Quarta." with subtitle line. Centred "Summarium." heading. Below it, one column of italic summary lines, left-aligned. Catchword bottom right with the number "10." beside it.

main_text.l: [?]ve quod eodem recidit, non esse ex hac

l.i: Juramentum ejus qui est sub alteri-

page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cut and dark, so the first letters of the top lines are doubtful, marked [?]. A small stray mark stands at the left margin beside "Juramentum ejus", not a letter. The number "10." at the foot is placed as signature; its nature is uncertain. Some printed letter forms (ct ligature in "Prælectio", the æ, the long J-like J in "Juramenti") are copied as they appear. Ornamental rule between the running text and the heading is not transcribed.
